descriptions.agreementThreshold: Set the minimum percentage of participating members who must agree.
descriptions.quorumEnabled: Require a minimum number of eligible channel members to participate before a proposal can pass.
descriptions.quorumThreshold: Set the minimum percentage of eligible channel members who must cast any vote.
descriptions.disagreementsLimit: Set a limit for the acceptable number of disagreements allowed for a proposal to still be able to pass.
descriptions.abstainsLimit: Set a limit for the acceptable number of abstains allowed for a proposal to still be able to pass.

descriptions.consentThresholdsDisabled: Quorum and agreement threshold do not apply to consent, which passes at the voting deadline when disagreements and abstentions stay within their limits and nobody blocks.
descriptions.votingTimeLimit: Set a time limit for how long proposals can be voted on before they're closed or ratified.
descriptions.blocksOpenToAll: When off, blocking needs a role that grants it. Everyone else can still disagree, which counts against the disagreement limit.

messages.projectDescription1: Praxis is an open source messaging platform designed for collaborative decision making. Proposals take center stage, offering a diverse range of voting models, with consensus as the default.
messages.projectDescription2: With Praxis, communities are empowered to collectively shape crucial aspects such as server name, settings, roles, and the planning of real-world events. This flexibility allows for diverse and dynamic social structures tailored to meet the specific needs of your community as it evolves over time.
messages.inDev: This project is still in development and is not yet intended for serious use outside of testing or research purposes.

hero.title: Turn the conversation into a decision.
hero.description: Praxis keeps chat, calls, proposals, votes, and collective decisions in one connected flow, so your group can move forward without losing the context that got you there.
hero.openSource: Free and open source software for groups that decide together.

mobileHero.description: Keep your group's conversations, focused discussion, and decisions together without losing the context that moves you forward.
mobileHero.conversationDescription: Chat and calls keep everyone connected to the context.
mobileHero.decisionDescription: Turn the discussion into a clear collective decision.

landing.bridge: Start with the way your group already talks. Add structure only when the moment calls for it.

developmentStatus.title: Praxis is still experimental.
developmentStatus.description: Praxis is under active development and intended only for testing and research.

chat.title: Familiar chat, with calls right where the conversation lives.
chat.description: Keep everyday coordination easy with messages and calls organized by topic. When a conversation needs more attention, the people and context are already in the same place.

forums.title: Give important questions room to become clear.
forums.description: Move from the fast pace of chat into forum discussions that gather replies around one topic. Your group can deliberate without starting over or scattering context across tools.

decisions.title: Shape a proposal, choose the rules, and ratify the result.
decisions.description: Use polls and proposals with configurable voting models to turn deliberation into a clear collective outcome. Decisions stay connected to the discussion that produced them.
